templates.label: Refresh when a Zigbee device updates
templates.description: Starts from any saved Zigbee device state update and asks the runtime for the latest state.

templates.label: Turn something on when motion is detected
templates.description: Use occupancy sensors, PIR sensors, and presence sensors to switch a Zigbee target on.

templates.label: Turn something off when a contact opens
templates.description: Use door, window, and contact sensors to turn a Zigbee target off.

templates.label: Dim a light from a Zigbee button
templates.description: Use action-capable remotes, buttons, and scene controllers to set a brightness level.

templates.label: Check a Zigbee device when battery is low
templates.description: Starts when a battery device reports a low battery state and refreshes it.

templates.label: Check a Zigbee safety alarm
templates.description: Starts from leak, smoke, gas, carbon monoxide, or tamper alarms and refreshes the reporting device.

devices.name: PiPhi Network Zigbee
devices.description: Automation metadata for Zigbee devices managed through Zigbee2MQTT exposes.

triggers.label: Device updates
triggers.description: Start when this device reports any new state.

triggers.label: Availability changes
triggers.description: Start when Zigbee2MQTT reports the device online or offline.

triggers.label: Motion detected
triggers.description: Start when occupancy or presence becomes active.

triggers.label: Motion cleared
triggers.description: Start when occupancy or presence becomes inactive.

triggers.label: Contact opened
triggers.description: Start when a door, window, or contact sensor opens.

triggers.label: Contact closed
triggers.description: Start when a door, window, or contact sensor closes.

triggers.label: Button action
triggers.description: Start when a remote, button, dimmer, or scene controller reports an action.

triggers.label: Environment changed
triggers.description: Start when temperature, humidity, pressure, or illuminance changes.

triggers.label: Power changed
triggers.description: Start when power, current, voltage, or energy readings change.

triggers.label: Position changed
triggers.description: Start when a cover, shade, valve, or similar position-capable device reports a new position.

triggers.label: Battery low
triggers.description: Start when a battery device reports low battery.

triggers.label: Safety alarm
triggers.description: Start when leak, smoke, gas, carbon monoxide, or tamper alarm data changes.

intents.label: Monitor this Zigbee device
intents.description: React to state, availability, battery, and diagnostic updates.

intents.label: Control Zigbee devices
intents.description: Send supported Zigbee2MQTT set commands to switches, plugs, dimmers, and lights.

intents.label: Protect the home
intents.description: Build automations around contact, leak, smoke, gas, carbon monoxide, and tamper sensors.

intents.label: Save energy
intents.description: React to metering, power, occupancy, and illuminance data.

intents.label: React to buttons and remotes
intents.description: Use action events from buttons, dimmers, remotes, and scene controllers.

intents.label: Maintain Zigbee devices
intents.description: Keep battery, availability, and link quality visible.

conditions.label: State matches
conditions.description: Only run when a reported text state value matches what you choose.

conditions.label: Boolean value is
conditions.description: Only run when a true or false Zigbee value matches.

conditions.label: Number compares
conditions.description: Only run when a numeric Zigbee value crosses a threshold.

conditions.label: Button action matches
conditions.description: Only run for a specific Zigbee button, remote, dimmer, or scene action.

conditions.label: Device is available
conditions.description: Only run when the device is online according to Zigbee2MQTT.

conditions.label: Safety sensors are clear
conditions.description: Only run when alarm-style safety values are false.

actions.label: Refresh
actions.description: Ask the Zigbee runtime for the latest state from the selected device.

actions.label: Set state
actions.description: Set an on/off style Zigbee device state.

actions.label: Set brightness
actions.description: Set a brightness percentage on Zigbee lights and dimmers.

actions.label: Set color temperature
actions.description: Set color temperature in mireds on compatible Zigbee lights.

manualOverride.label: Skip while device is unavailable
manualOverride.description: Avoid running this behavior when Zigbee2MQTT marks the device unavailable.

notes: Device support is derived from Zigbee2MQTT exposes instead of per-model behavior entries.
This catalog only advertises runtime actions currently implemented by the PiPhi Zigbee integration.
